topic: AI Gateway Comparison 2026: Kong vs Portkey vs LiteLLM vs Zuplo for LLM Routing
keyword: Kong vs Portkey vs LiteLLM AI gateway

competitors.title: Kong AI Gateway — Secure, Scalable AI Gateway for AI Connectivity
key_points: Enterprise-grade AI gateway governing LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic on a single platform
Part of Kong Konnect unified API and AI platform with API Gateway, Event Gateway, and Service Mesh
Features include LLM governance, MCP governance, cost control, AI security, and full observability
Supports KAi Agent for AI-assisted API management and Context Mesh for agentic workloads
Enterprise pricing model — contact sales for quotes; no self-service tiers
Plugin ecosystem with 200+ plugins including AI-specific ones for prompt injection detection and PII masking
Built on top of Kong Gateway (NGINX/OpenResty), proven at handling millions of requests per second
MCP Registry for discovering and managing MCP servers across the organization

competitors.title: Portkey AI Gateway — World's Fastest AI Gateway with Advanced Routing
key_points: Open-source AI gateway handling 2B+ requests and tracking $93M+ in LLM spend
Conditional routing with 9 operators ($eq, $ne, $in, $nin, $regex, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte) and $and/$or logic
Semantic cache using cosine similarity (default 0.95 threshold) for serving cached semantically similar requests
Load balancing across multiple API keys to counter rate limits
Circuit breaker with per-strategy protection and failure handling
Canary testing for new models in production
MCP support for connecting to remote MCP servers
Guardrails for content filtering and PII masking
Self-hosted (open-source) or cloud-managed deployment options
Also offers Agent Gateway for AI agent governance and observability

competitors.title: LiteLLM — Unified Interface for 100+ LLMs with Self-Hosted Proxy
key_points: Open-source library providing a single unified interface to call 100+ LLMs using OpenAI format
Router with 6 strategies: weighted pick, rate-limit aware v2, latency-based, least-busy, lowest-cost, custom
Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and admin UI
Built-in retry/fallback logic across multiple deployments via the Router
Observability integrations with Langfuse, MLflow, Helicone, Lunary, and more
Guardrails for content filtering, PII masking, and safety checks
Enterprise features: SSO/SAML, audit logs, advanced security
Also serves as unified gateway for LLMs, agents (A2A), and MCP — no separate gateway needed
Python SDK + Proxy Server; Docker deployment supported
Open-source (MIT license) with active community on GitHub

competitors.title: Zuplo AI Gateway — Fully-Managed Edge AI Gateway with Team Budgets
key_points: Fully-managed edge API gateway with AI-specific features built on edge runtime
Multi-provider support: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI, and OpenAI-compatible custom providers
Team hierarchy with cascading budgets: root team → sub-teams → applications with daily/monthly limits
Semantic caching for similar prompts to reduce costs and improve response times
Security guardrails for prompt injection detection and PII leakage prevention
Full observability with real-time dashboards for request counts, token usage, and spending
Self-service developer access — developers create apps without needing provider API keys
Git-based deployment workflow with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps
Also offers MCP Server, Developer Portal, and API monetization features
Free tier available; paid plans for production use
